of.needed: whether the environment has Go code that imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime as a module dependency

original.statement: The Go module path for Crossplane and Crossplane Runtime has changed from `github.com/crossplane/crossplane` and `github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime` to include a `v2` suffix: `github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2` and `github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2`; all import statements in code must be updated.

exposure.needed: whether the environment has Go code whose go.mod imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime and is being updated to v2+

corrected.statement: The Go module paths changed to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 and github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2. This exposes any Go code that imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime and updates to v2+. Static environment inputs do not show this, so it is undecidable from them.

decision.reason: [ev-d241daaf3863] says only Go code that imports `crossplane` or `crossplane-runtime` through go.mod is affected, once that code moves its dependency to v2+. That depends on the user's code base, not on which Crossplane version is deployed. The proposed product-version{crossplane >=2.0.0} conjunct ties exposure to the installed release. Before the upgrade it evaluates false, so it would hide environments that are exposed. Exposure should be the undecidable leaf alone.
